autocorrelation.note: matched cell pairs at each lag.  The headline numbers weight each cell pair by n_a * n_b -- the number of row pairs it carries, the same weight the cross-product table uses -- and `per_cell` repeats them with one weight per cell.  `rho_plugin` is the assignment's statistic on the plug-in mean; `rho_debiased` removes the within-cell noise from the denominator only, because noise in two different bins is independent

crossover_population.note: the matched rule is row-level: a row is kept when all four relations have at least one counterpart, so every relation is estimated on the same rows and the same days

q10_predeclared_rule.note: the queue's rule is on the CELL and is applied before any covariance; the population read is the chosen 2x2 subgrid, so every relation has at least three rows at each corner

variance_components.note: cov(diff,diff) = Var(window); each same-X row minus it is Var(X | window); the fourth cell is the additivity check, not an assumption

fractions_of_the_shared_component.note: the assignment's own denominator: the shared component read on the SAME rows.  These four do not add to 100 % -- the components are conditional variances whose sum is the same-runway-same-operator relation, while the shared component is the pair-weighted average over all four

variance_components_matched.note: cov(diff,diff) = Var(window); each same-X row minus it is Var(X | window); the fourth cell is the additivity check, not an assumption

fractions_of_the_shared_component.note: the assignment's own denominator: the shared component read on the SAME rows.  These four do not add to 100 % -- the components are conditional variances whose sum is the same-runway-same-operator relation, while the shared component is the pair-weighted average over all four

july_loo.crossover_coverage_note: counted on the matched rows only (all four relations non-empty), so an airport that meets the rule meets it on the population the components are read on

observables.cross_fitted_r2_note: the first is the count-weighted out-of-block R^2 of the PLUG-IN cell mean, whose denominator carries the within-cell noise E[Var(eps)/n_c] that no model can reach; the second removes that noise from both sides and is the assignment's oracle-free upper bound
observables.feature_note: cell means of the exp-039 row feature set (359 columns) plus the count/window block; NOT the literal v10 member frame, which is not reproducible at this cost

observables.cross_fitted_r2_note: the first is the count-weighted out-of-block R^2 of the PLUG-IN cell mean, whose denominator carries the within-cell noise E[Var(eps)/n_c] that no model can reach; the second removes that noise from both sides and is the assignment's oracle-free upper bound
observables.feature_note: cell means of the exp-039 row feature set (359 columns) plus the count/window block; NOT the literal v10 member frame, which is not reproducible at this cost
